about: Golf's defaults, as data (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md track L, L5 part 3): a sport's standard scoring, lineup slots and locks, and the game specs a sport's Make it a game starts from instead of asking the bot. Stat keys are Golf's (src/lib/sports/golf.ts), the same for every stroke-play tour ESPN carries; the kinds of holes, bogey-free rounds and birdie streaks need a tour whose feed has holes (the PGA Tour, PGA Tour Champions, the Korn Ferry Tour), so on the LPGA, the DP World Tour and LIV a game scores what rounds say (strokes, score to par, rounds under 70, the finish). Yahoo scores a finishing place by a table of places; the game spec's points are one number a stat (A1's schema, on the engine branch), so `points` has the holes' and rounds', and `byPlace` the places' (POS's: the tied each take the place's points; a withdrawal has none), for when the spec scores places. A hole in one is an eagle (or a double eagle) and a hole in one: both score. The specs are in the game spec's shape; slots and the places aren't in that schema yet (L4 adds them), so they're kept beside it for the spec to read.

scoring.source: Yahoo's daily fantasy golf (2018's table, thegolfnewsnet.com/ryan_ballengee/2018/06/20/yahoo-introduced-daily-fantasy-dfs-golf-game-109920; its official rules, legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/terms/rules/dailyfantasygolf: the tied each take the place's points, playoff holes score nothing and only decide the places, a withdrawal or disqualification keeps its holes' points but has no place, a bogey-free round needs the round played, only a round's longest birdie streak counts): a hole in one 5, a double eagle 15, an eagle 9, a birdie 3.5, a par 0.5, a bogey -1.3, a double bogey or worse -5; a bogey-free round 5; a round's longest streak of birdies or better, three 3, four 5, five 10, six or more 18; the 1st place 25, 2nd 12, 3rd 10, 4th to 10th 8, 11th to 20th 3

categories.source: Yahoo's and DraftKings' golf score points, not categories: none by default

slots.source: Yahoo's daily fantasy golf: six golfers (any six: golf has no positions; its $200 salary cap isn't a slot)

season.about: A season of tournaments: draft six golfers, all six play each tournament, most points over the season wins.

short.about: One tournament: everyone drafts a few golfers, every one of them scores, most points wins.
